Maria L.: Heads up — FinCo (large enterprise) asked for two things in contract: 1) commit elasticity (ability to shift up to 40% of monthly reserved commit between months) and 2) a "guest credit" pool that partners can draw from and that preferentially routes to Dedicated capacity. They want this codified in the agreement. Need product/legal/finance/eng inputs.
Sam P.: Quick q — do we have their expected monthly baseline? 40% feels high.
Jordan (AE): They projected ~2.5M tokens/month for Q3 ramp. 40% is their buffer for marketing spikes. Guest credits = up to 10% of commit, routed to dedicated but failover to hosted when capacity constrained. They'll sign if we provide a soft-floor SLA for committed baseline.
Rachael - Finance: Important: elasticity + guest routing changes unit economics. Two levers: (A) let elasticity be free and absorb burst (bigger reserved capacity) or (B) charge a burst premium above baseline. Need a model for 2.5M tokens to see margin impact.
Bryan - SRE: Engineering notes: routing guest credits into Dedicated w/ fallback to Hosted is feasible. Key pieces: routing policy, priority lanes, quota arithmetic. Example config: `guest_pool_limit = 0.1 * commit` and `elastic_pct = 0.4`. We'll need per-tenant priority tags so dedicated nodes prefer committed traffic.
commit-bot: Branch created: feat/guest-credit-routing (#482) — CI started.
Maria L.: Product proposal (high level):
- Feature name: "Elastic Commit"
- Params: `elastic_pct` (0-40%), `guest_pool_pct` (0-15%)
- Availability: paid add-on for Dedicated and Private
- Contract primitives: max_elastic_pct, guest_pool_pct, non-transferable guest flag
- Launch criteria:
  1) Legal signoff on clause language
  2) Finance approves P&L model
  3) Routing feature in canary + canary run >= 7 days
  4) e2e failover tests passing
  5) Docs + pricing page updated
Sam P.: Rollout idea: pilot FinCo on Dedicated (private control plane) — 2-week canary, measure cost delta & latency. If delta too high, tier with burst premium.
Rachael - Finance: Suggest metric: `cost_per_committed_token_delta <= 20%` (back-of-envelope) to enable without premium. Also propose minimums: min monthly commit = 100k tokens to opt into Elastic Commit.
Jordan (AE): FinCo ok with min commit. They require partner billing — guest credits billed to partner org monthly and CSV export of partner usage.
Bryan - SRE: Ops checklist (initial):
- routing policy + priority tags
- per-tenant quotas: `guest.usage`, `elastic.shifted_tokens`
- fallback path: Dedicated -> Hosted
- observability: guest.failovers metric and alert >5% failover rate
- Can we ship without CSV export for pilot? easier.
Maria L.: Decision request: Product to own spec & contract language draft, Legal to vet, Finance to run full P&L, Eng to scope ETA. Sync TOMORROW 11:00am PT?
Sam P.: :thumbsup: I'll draft the spec today and push to PR. @Rachael please run quick model. @Bryan can you confirm rough effort in points?
Rachael - Finance: Running a quick back-of-envelope now, will post delta numbers here in thread by EOD.
Bryan - SRE: Rough eng effort: ~3 sprints for routing+quotas+tests + 1 sprint for canary infra. If we cut CSV export and advanced billing, could be 2 sprints + canary.
Jordan (AE): I'll align FinCo for pilot start target: earliest July. Need contract draft by next Tue to keep timeline.
Maria L.: Note: prefer guest credits to be explicitly non-transferable between top-level orgs unless authorized. Also want a short FAQ for customers about failover behavior.
